messages.content:
Task: On u.caixin.com login, clicking login POSTs a payload whose `password` field is an encrypted token (e.g. 13819912565 becomes Wy0AkgthChYWCDF9MwOCyQ==). Locate the anchor function for that login request. The anchor function is the target-specific login submit handler on the submit->request chain: the single complete function whose own body reads the form, binds the password into the payload by running it through encode(encrypt(...)), assembles the request object and posts it — rather than the AES encrypt function it calls to produce the ciphertext (a nested target-specific helper), the generic URL-encode utility it also applies to several fields (a core utility), or the inverse decrypt function (an off-chain decoy). Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do NOT return the encrypt function, the encode utility, or the decrypt function — return the submit handler that binds the encrypted password into the request. Only code under captures is in scope.  network_request POST login password 13819912565 Wy0AkgthChYWCDF9MwOCyQ==
